== What is Idle Obelisk Miner? ==
<div class="homepage-intro" style="padding:0.5em;">[[File:Game Icon.png|200px|right]]</div>
<div class="homepage-intro">'''Idle Obelisk Miner''' is a game developed by Checkbox Entertainment. It is an idle / incremental / clicker game about mining rocks, crafting bars and progressing through vast upgrade trees to progress further into the mines.

You can engage in both active and idle gameplay, and there's a focus on prestige mechanics to further advance. The game's core involves collecting resources, defeating the Obelisk for rewards, and unlocking new content.  

It has offline progression and offers in-app purchases for boosts.</div>

[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/idle-obelisk-miner/id6448125670  Download on the App Store]<br>
